task_completion.description: The rule is set to trigger on 'Motion' for the 'Loading Dock Camera'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target camera is 'Loading Dock Camera'. The internal API name for the motion event is 'cameraMotionEvent' and for the play sound action is 'playSoundAction'. The required interval is exactly 60 seconds (1 minute). The agent must use the web interface at https://localhost:7001.
